S021.name: Disorganized_Thinking_Speech
S021.description: Symptoms where speech or thought appears scattered and difficult to follow due to a lack of logical or consistent flow.

subtypes.Derailment or Loose Associations: A speech pattern of switching rapidly from one topic to another with no logical connection between thoughts.
subtypes.Tangentiality: Speech that deviates entirely from the question and fails to answer directly.
subtypes.Incoherence or Word Salad: Severe fragmentation of speech and sentence structure, making it nearly impossible to understand.
subtypes.Neologisms: Using made-up words that have meaning only to the individual.
subtypes.Clang Associations: Speech governed by sounds, such as rhyming, rather than the meaning of words.

S022.name: Disorganized_Abnormal_Behavior
S022.description: A state where behavior and motor control are severely disturbed, appearing as movements or reactions inappropriate to the situation.

subtypes.Childlike Silliness: Inappropriate, childish, or illogical behavior appearing in situations.
subtypes.Stupor: No psychomotor activity; not actively relating to environment.
subtypes.Catalepsy: Passive induction of a posture held against gravity.
subtypes.Waxy Flexibility: Slight, even resistance to positioning by examiner.
subtypes.Mutism: No, or very little, verbal response despite the ability to speak.
subtypes.Negativism: Opposition or no response to instructions or external stimuli without apparent motive.
subtypes.Posturing: Spontaneous and active maintenance of a posture against gravity.
subtypes.Mannerism: Odd, circumstantial caricature of normal actions.
subtypes.Agitation: Excessive motor activity without obvious external cause.
subtypes.Grimacing: Contorted facial expressions irrelevant to the situation.

patient_info.stressor: Richard moved from Ellisville into a shared apartment closer to his warehouse job and community-college classes, losing the predictable home routines that had anchored his work, fishing trips, and church volunteering. Over the next 11 months, his coworkers saw his usually careful task lists turn into scattered instructions that slowed loading shifts, while his conduct around equipment and break-room routines became inappropriate enough to raise safety concerns. The decline affected nearly every part of his life: he stopped keeping up with classes, missed church food-bank shifts, and was eventually removed from forklift duties after repeated disorganized incidents on the warehouse floor. Following a serious workplace disruption, his supervisor contacted his family, and Richard was taken for urgent psychiatric assessment.

S021.name: Disorganized_Thinking_Speech
S021.description: Symptoms where speech or thought appears scattered and difficult to follow due to a lack of logical or consistent flow.
S021.manifestation: When the supervisor asks me which pallets are going on the truck, I start trying to explain but my words jump from the load sheet to my old house, then fishing, then church boxes, and by the time I'm done nobody knows what I meant.

S022.name: Disorganized_Abnormal_Behavior
S022.description: A state where behavior and motor control are severely disturbed, appearing as movements or reactions inappropriate to the situation.
S022.manifestation: I guess they brought me in because at the warehouse I keep doing things like freezing with my arms up by the forklift, copying the beeping sounds and hand signals, or moving boxes in strange little patterns even when everyone is yelling for me to stop.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’ve lost my forklift duties, fallen behind in my community-college classes, and stopped showing up for the church food-bank shifts because people say they can’t count on me or keep things safe around me anymore.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: Things have been going downhill for about 11 months, since I moved into the shared apartment closer to work and school.

psychotic_symptoms_duration.name: Psychotic Symptoms Duration
psychotic_symptoms_duration.manifestation: The confusing talking and strange behavior at the warehouse have been happening for about six months now.
